description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Seating: Two sofas in the lower-left living zone facing each other across a coffee table, with the TV against the left exterior wall; dining table with 6 seats positioned upper-centre near the kitchen.. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor.
